patterns.note: Alternating full-width image and text sections, with text often aligned to the right, creating a balanced yet dynamic flow down the page.
A sophisticated pairing of a classic serif font for prominent headings and a clean sans-serif for body text and navigation, establishing an elegant and authoritative tone.
An earthy and muted color palette featuring warm off-white backgrounds, rich brown accents, and dark text, evoking a sense of natural elegance and timelessness.
The full-bleed hero video scrolls up and out of view, revealing the main content sections below, while the navigation bar transitions from transparent to a solid background as it becomes sticky.
Content sections are clearly delineated by generous vertical spacing and distinct background colors, creating a clean visual rhythm.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-bleed, auto-playing video that scrolls away to reveal the page content. A subtle dark overlay ensures text readability over the dynamic background.
The primary navigation bar is initially transparent and overlays the hero video. As the user scrolls past the hero, it becomes sticky at the top of the viewport and gains a solid, light background.
Main content sections are introduced with a subtle reveal animation, appearing to slide up or fade in as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement as the user scrolls.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (~3x body) are paired with smaller, legible sans-serif body text and very small, uppercase sans-serif labels for navigation and metadata.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy in hero and main content sections, with balanced padding in grid layouts and forms, contributing to an open and refined feel.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a cinematic, full-bleed video hero combined with a classic, editorial serif typography and an earthy color palette creates a high-end, established, and emotionally resonant brand presence that feels both modern and timeless.
